title: 16th Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/16/2/2026).
Approval of the minutes of six previous sittings (minutes Nos. 10/2/2026 to 15/2/2026).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for the Maldives' Permanent Representative to the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of the Foreign Service Act (Law No. 20/2021), is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

Unfinished business: continued debate on the resolution by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir noting that many people are being politically dismissed from state-owned companies under the name of downsizing, to establish Parliament's view on the matter.
Public Accounts Committee report on the special audit of Fenaka Corporation Limited's Addu City branches and projects (2021-2023).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting approved six sets of minutes, sent the IRENA envoy nominee to committee, continued the SOE dismissals resolution debate, and took a Fenaka Addu audit report.
